items.title: At least 4 killed, over 40 injured as Peshawar-bound train derails in Punjab's Multan district
items.description:

items.description:

items.title: Pakistan condemns Israeli actions in Syria, calls for withdrawal
items.description:
UNITED NATIONS: Pakistan has condemned continued Israeli military actions in Syria, calling for Israel’s withdrawal from all occupied Syrian territory and full respect for the 1974 Disengagement of Forces Agreement.
Speaking at a UN Security Council briefing on the humanitarian and political situation in Syria on Monday evening, Pakistan’s Acting Permanent Representative, Ambassador Usman Jadoon, said Israeli actions violated international law and Syria’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, undermining prospects for regional peace and stability.

items.title: Super El Nino set to make 2026 record hottest year
items.description:
BRUSSELS: An intensifying El Nino pattern set an all-time temperature high in a key Pacific zone in September and could help make this year the hottest globally on record, the director of the EU’s climate monitor said on Monday.
Global forecasters have been warning for months that this El Nino would likely become the strongest ever observed and the latest record has tumbled even before the episode’s expected peak later this year.

items.title: ‘Pakistan’s poverty rate higher than India, B’desh’
items.description:
WASHINGTON: More than one-third of Pakistan’s population faces overlapping deprivations in health, education and living standards, according to the United Nations Development Prog­ramme’s (UNDP) Multidimensional Pov­er­ty Index (MPI) released on Monday.

Figures released by the UNDP in New York show that 38.3 per cent of Pakistan’s population was multidimensionally poor, compared with 16.4 per cent in India and 14.9pc in Bangladesh.
